title: Prepare a statement of cash flows using the cash T-account approach

items.concept: Reconstruct all cash and noncash entries from comparative balance sheets and the income statement; complete the cash T-account; prepare the statement of cash flows (direct method for operating activities)
Number-variant twin — reconstruct entries, equipment/RE schedules, cash T-account, and direct-method SCF with different amounts (includes gain on disposal and note principal repayment)
Period-end depreciation JE (noncash); PPE disposal JE; bond maturity/settlement JE; map only cash legs into investing/financing sections of the cash T-account; classification of each flow
Classification — which reconstructed items appear in the cash T-account; treatment of restricted cash in the SCF reconciliation
